content.title: Implement --branch flag per updated spec
content.description:
Spec: .agentic/specs/configurable-branch-spec.md (REVIEWED status)

Implement the --branch flag on agt init following the updated spec. Key deliverables:

1. New file: src/core/pointer.ts - read/write .agentrack.json pointer file, resolveBranch() helper
2. Modify src/cli/init.ts - parse --branch flag, normalize, pass to worktree, write pointer file
3. Modify src/core/worktree.ts - replace hardcoded constants with parameterized branch/dir, add normalizeBranchName() (reject slashes), add resolveWorktreePaths() using pointer file
4. Modify src/core/resolution.ts - replace hardcoded AGENTACK_DIR with pointer-file-based discovery in resolveTrackerDir()
5. Modify src/core/tracker.ts - replace hardcoded AGENTACK_DIR with pointer-file-based or parameter-based discovery
6. Modify src/cli/push.ts - resolve branch from pointer file
7. Modify src/cli/pull.ts - resolve branch from pointer file
8. Modify src/types/config.ts - add optional branch field to Config interface
9. Modify src/index.ts - export DEFAULT_BRANCH/DEFAULT_DIR instead of WORKTREE_BRANCH/WORKTREE_DIR

CRITICAL NOTES from review:
- The pointer file (.agentrack.json) at repo root solves the circular discovery problem
- Reject branch names with slashes (AC8)
- resolution.ts resolveTrackerDir() must use pointer file during walk-up
- tracker.ts AGENTACK_DIR must also be dynamic
- gitignore handling must be parameterized for the actual dir name
- Commit messages must use actual branch/dir names (not hardcoded _agentrack)
- checkPreconditions must check against the target branch name

Acceptance criteria: AC1 through AC8 in the spec. All existing tests must continue to pass. New behavior should be manually verified with agt init --branch testname in a temp git repo.

content.content:
Done. Implemented the remaining pieces of the --branch flag feature:

1. **branch-config.ts** — Added specific slash rejection error message (AC8): 'Branch name cannot contain slashes (slashes would create nested directories)'. Also improved the generic validation error message to use 'Branch name ...' format per AC6.

2. **tracker.ts** — Removed hardcoded AGENTACK_DIR constant. Tracker.init() now accepts optional dirName parameter and falls back to resolveWorktreeOptions() (pointer file discovery). This fixes a bug where init() would always create .agentrack/ even when a custom branch was specified.

3. **init.ts** — Fixed both git and non-git paths to pass opts.dir to tracker.init(). Made writeBranchToConfig conditional (only writes branch field for non-default branches, preserving backward compat per AC7).

4. **worktree.ts** — Updated commitGitignoreChange() to also stage and commit the .agentrack.json pointer file when it exists, ensuring the pointer file gets committed to the main branch during fresh init (per spec requirement).

Verification: typecheck passes, lint passes, all 649 existing tests pass with 0 failures.
